description: Must keep passing: real alternative names still find the brand: 7-11 (on 15 POIs of the map) finds 7-Eleven, lotus finds Lotus's go fresh (Tesco Lotus Express on 3 of its 17 POIs) and its POIs. The extract thailand_brand_translations is cut out of Thailand_asia_2.obf: the POIs nearest to Bangkok of each brand and up to 5 POIs per alternative name that produce it (the name of the POI equals the brand and one of its name:xx is that alternative).
